arguments.query: select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("bookings","charges","outbox","fare_holds")

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents camt from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select length(payload) l, payload from outbox where status="pending"
select path,status,message,count(*) n,max(rowid) r from request_logs where service="booking" and rowid>(select max(rowid)-120 from request_logs) group by path,status,message
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("flights","cache")
select "fh" t,flight_id a,price_cents b,until_step c from fare_holds union all select "fl",flight_id,price_cents,version from flights union all select "cache",* ,"" from cache
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from request_logs where rowid>(select max(rowid)-60 from request_logs) group by 1,2,3,4
select rowid,service,path,status,message from request_logs where service in ("booking","pricing") order by rowid desc limit 20

select "nocharge" k,b.booking_id id,b.status s,b.amount_cents a,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured") n from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and ((select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")!=1 or not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) or not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) union all select "badamt",c.booking_id,c.state,c.amount_cents,0 from charges c join bookings b using(booking_id) where c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents or c.state not in ("captured") union all select "orphan",charge_id,state,0,0 from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings)
